subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + demo — security review follow-up

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security review started: 

- Stakeholders identified on the call:
  - Technical lead / security reviewer: Alex Johnson (thanks for volunteering to coordinate)
  - Legal / contract owner: Tom Reynolds (CC'd on future threads)
  - Procurement / purchasing: Priya Shah
  - Economic buyer / business sponsor: Sanjay Patel

- Decision criteria you called out: data residency & encryption, audit logs & retention, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable latency for inference.

Next steps:
1) We'll kick off a security questionnaire intake — Neha will send the questionnaire and a short intake form to capture systems in scope.
2) Please confirm the systems (prod, staging, ETL pipelines) and whether there are any third-party connectors we should include.
3) Proposed kickoff: Tue 10/05 between 10–11am PT or Wed 10/06 2–3pm PT. Which works best for the full stakeholder group?

Attachments: I attached the V1 questionnaire we usually start with (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx) — Neha will follow up with technical details.

Looking forward — I put Rishi on the thread to surface any commercial constraints early.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Intro + demo — security review follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear next steps. Quick mapping from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Sanjay Patel (VP Engineering) — will be looped in for final sign-off on capacity and pricing.
- Procurement: Priya Shah — she handles PO + vendor onboarding.
- Legal: Tom Reynolds — will need copies of standard DPA + security posture summary.
- Security reviewer / technical SME: me (Alex) and one of our infra engineers (I’ll add Neeraj if needed).

Systems in scope (initial ask):
- Production inference cluster (prod-redwood-acme) — primary
- Staging (staging-redwood-acme) — optional
- Data ingestion API endpoints (POST /v1/predict)
- S3 buckets used for model artifacts and logs (us-west-2)

We can do Tue 10/05 10:30am PT for a 45-minute kickoff — that works for me, Priya, and Tom is OK to join but may be on mobile for the first 15 minutes.

I attached our network diagram and checklist (acme-network-diagram.pdf) — it calls out a few third-party connectors (analytics-pipeline via Snowflake, external document storage).

Alex
Alex Johnson 
Head of Security, Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Intro + demo — security review follow-up

Perfect — thanks Alex. 10/05 10:30am PT is on our side as well. I’ll create the calendar invite and include a short agenda: 1) intake review (systems in scope) 2) questionnaire walkthrough 3) evidence & timeline for SOC 2 / logs / retention.

Neha — will you send the questionnaire and a short intake form that lists the exact endpoints/hosts we should include? Also flag any additional info we’ll need to collect for legal/procurement.

Rishi — looping you for any commercial constraints (contract duration, ELA vs pay-as-you-go) that might affect the procurement path.

Thanks everyone — invite coming shortly.

Best,
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood security questionnaire + tech intake (Acme Health)

Hi Alex / team —

Following up with the intake form and questionnaire we discussed. Attached: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (high level) and a short technical intake template below. Please fill and return before the kickoff if possible — it will help us keep the meeting to 45 minutes.

Technical intake (please paste answers into the attached template):
- Systems in scope (prod/staging): list hostnames / cluster ids
- API endpoints (path + auth method)
- Data types sent to Redwood (PHI/PII/metadata)
- Retention requirements for logs / request traces
- KMS / key management in use (if any)
- Any IP allowlists or egress restrictions

Attachments referenced (stubs):
- redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (questionnaire)
- technical-intake-template.txt (short form)

If you prefer, we can do a 15-minute pre-kickoff call with Alex & Neeraj to fill the intake live — otherwise, sending the completed templates by EOD Monday helps us prep evidence.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood security questionnaire + tech intake (Acme Health)

Thanks Neha — we can provide the intake by EOD today. A couple clarifications before we fill: 

- For data types: we will be sending limited PHI (de-identified patient summaries) — is there a recommended field-level redaction approach you prefer?
- Retention: we need logs retained for 7 years for auditability — will Redwood support that retention period or do you have a recommended export cadence?

I attached the network diagram we referenced (acme-network-diagram.pdf) and a short vendor onboarding checklist for procurement.

We’re confirmed for Tue 10/05 10:30am PT — I’ll accept the invite. Please add the DocuSign link or DPA summary to the meeting notes if possible; Tom will want to review the DPA before full procurement engagement.

--
Alex Johnson
Head of Security, Acme Health
